name: CSS - Colors & Backgrounds
description: Master colors, backgrounds, and visual styling

rules.text: Create a div element with some text
rules.hint: Add a div container to your HTML: <div>This is my content</div>. Divs are generic containers for grouping content.

rules.text: Give the div a background color using CSS
rules.hint: Style your div: div { background-color: lightblue; }. Background-color changes the background of an element.

rules.text: Add padding to create space inside the div
rules.hint: Add padding to your div: div { background-color: lightblue; padding: 20px; }. Padding creates space between content and borders.

completion.message: 🎉 Perfect! You've mastered colors and backgrounds!
